description: Purchase orders and vendor transactions involving a flagged potential conflict of interest (personal, familial, or financial relationship between the requestor and the vendor) require formal disclosure and compliance clearance before spend is incurred.

policy_references.citation: Internal Vendor Conflict of Interest Standard
policy_references.notes: No confirmed, currently-enacted Barbados private-sector conflict-of-interest statute was found. The Integrity in Public Life Bill (which would cover public officials, not private-sector vendor relationships) failed in the Senate in 2020 and was reintroduced in 2023, passing the Lower House per contemporaneous reporting, but enactment/Senate passage was not confirmed as of this research. This control therefore rests on internal policy alone; revisit if that Act's status is confirmed.
